title: Sparkly key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='42' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.25'/>

  <circle cx='26' cy='48' r='9' fill='#1B2233'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='48' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#FFE28A' stroke-width='2'/>
